text:
morgan: Heads-up PR #1930 is blocked by errref-link-check on content/errors/429.md (3 broken links + one missing include).

tara: which include? I can patch quickly.

morgan: include pointed to sdk/v1/429-handling.md which moved to sdk/handlers/retry-429.md during the snippet reorg. Also two vendor links are 404/redirect loop.

linh: I can update the include in the PR to the new path and run the snippet harness.

samir: for vendor links, propose we replace with internal playbook /playbooks/rate-limits/overview.md or archive.org snapshot. Also draft an inline opt-out: <!-- linkcheck:ignore --> for curated vendor refs.

devex: style: keep top-level pseudo-code client-agnostic, then language blocks collapsed. Add a small Retry-After header example for 429s.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint failed on branch morgan/429-refresh errref-link-check.

morgan: action items: 1) @linh update include to sdk/handlers/retry-429.md + run snippets/test-runner, 2) @tara swap two vendor links to playbook/archive, 3) @samir add opt-out comment proposal to #1931. I'll re-run lint after patches.

tara: will do, pushing small link swaps now.

linh: pushed include fix and ran harness locally. snippet test passed.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed on updated branch. merging after approvals.

morgan: filed follow-up #1931 for linkcheck opt-out and lightweight pre-merge link check. thanks all!
